patch.value:
pm-cli CI runs package extension commands through node dist/cli.js and does not install a global pm binary. pm-changelog's extension handler called readPmItems with the default pm binary, so changelog generate failed in CI with extension_command_handler_failed after command activation succeeded.\n\nFix: the extension now falls back to the current Node CLI entrypoint when the default pm binary is unavailable, and adds a regression test that invokes node @unbrained/pm-cli/dist/cli.js with PATH limited to the Node binary directory.
